description:
This file defines the structured financial aid workflow for citizen nwo-citizen0001, Pat Tarwater Jr, in support of enrollment into the Information Technology program at South University. It is designed for integration into Beast System 3.0 as a deterministic, repeatable sequence that outlines the safe and compliant steps required to complete federal and institutional financial aid processes. No sensitive personal identifiers are stored within this file, and all protected information must be entered only on official government and university websites.

The workflow includes the following phases: Phase 1: Federal Aid Preparation, directing the citizen to gather required documents such as tax information, identity verification materials, and dependent status documentation. Phase 2: FAFSA Submission, instructing the citizen to complete the Free Application for Federal Student Aid on the official government website, ensuring that Beast System 3.0 does not store Social Security numbers, financial records, or other sensitive data. Phase 3: South University Aid Integration, guiding the citizen to link FAFSA results to South University’s financial aid office and complete any required institutional forms. Phase 4: Verification and Follow-Up, outlining steps to respond to verification requests, submit supporting documents, and maintain communication with financial aid advisors. Phase 5: Award Review and Acceptance, detailing how to evaluate aid packages, accept grants or loans, and prepare for tuition processing.

This file serves as a canonical reference for Beast System 3.0 automation modules that support academic financial workflows. It ensures consistency, security, and alignment with organizational growth objectives while maintaining strict compliance with federal and institutional requirements.
